issues.extracted: difference 192,190 attributed to General Fund pooling / missing 162,000 transfer entry
issues.on_page: School Nutrition Fund: receipts 436,119, disbursements 532,214, Excess printed 96,095 (no parentheses); ending 339,025 = 435,120 - 96,095
issues.issue: The 192,190 figure is right and it really is a report error, not a misread or a missed line. But the cause is the sign of the School Nutrition excess: it is printed as +96,095 when it should be (96,095), and 2 x 96,095 = 192,190. Every other row's Excess cell is consistent with its own receipts, disbursements and transfers (General 12,218,747 - 11,372,878 - 55,500 = 790,369; Activities -74,236 + 55,500 = -18,736). The printed column total 1,280,444 is the correct sum of the printed cells. The pooling and the 162,000 transfer don't affect this column. The note should name the Nutrition sign error.

issues.on_page: p4 prints Non-Revenue Receipts 209,714 (General 180,128, Nutrition 5,961, Special Building 23,625) with no breakdown
issues.issue: The split was worked out by elimination. The 750 (1910 Rentals) and 1,439 (1920 Donations) sit under Local Sources on p6, not Non-Revenue Sources, so the schedule doesn't print them as part of this line. The arithmetic ties exactly (180,128 = 15,939 + 750 + 1,439 + 162,000). Applies to receipts[22] to receipts[26].
